title: Slushie Bar Salts Red Apple Raspberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Red Apple Raspberry from Slushie Bar Salts is an enticing blend that combines the crispness of Red Apples with the sweet tang of Raspberries. This e-liquid captures the freshness of a ripe, juicy red apple on the inhale, offering a flavour that is both sweet and slightly tart. The apple's natural freshness is perfectly complemented by the addition of raspberries, which bring a delightful berry sweetness to the mix. The interplay between the two fruits creates a harmonious and multi-layered vaping experience. The raspberry's tangy notes lift the apple's sweetness, resulting in a balanced and refreshing vape that is ideal for all-day enjoyment. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
